definitions.explanation: A type of graph that uses rectangular bars of varying heights or lengths to represent and compare quantities of data.

examples.japanese: {棒|ぼう}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棒|ぼう}グラフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To compare the populations of various countries using a bar graph.

examples.japanese: {棒|ぼう}グラフ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ→折れ線グラフ：20687_oresengurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧、⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{利益率|りえきりつ}→利益率：22300_riekiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: By combining a bar graph and a line graph, you can show sales and profit margins at the same time.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (rod/bar) + ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (graph). Named after the bar-shaped columns used to display data.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棒|ぼう}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to create a bar graph
- {棒|ぼう}グラフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compare using a bar graph
- {棒|ぼう}グラフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to represent with a bar graph
- ⟦{積|つ}み{上|あ}げ→積み上げる：07920_tsumiageru⟧{棒|ぼう}グラフ: stacked bar graph

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ→折れ線グラフ：20687_oresengurafu⟧: line graph — shows trends over time with connected points
- ⟦{円|えん}グラフ→円グラフ：19567_engurafu⟧: pie chart — shows proportions as sectors of a circle
- ヒストグラム: histogram — similar in appearance but shows frequency distributions

USAGE:
{棒|ぼう}グラフ is best suited for comparing quantities across categories. It is one of the first graph types taught in Japanese schools, typically introduced in the third grade of elementary school.
